family.description: This is the N-terminal domain found in Lactate racemase enzymes [ec:5.1.2.1]. LarA is a nickel-dependent lactate racemase from the larA-E operon of Lactobacillus plantarum, whereas LarB, LarC and LarE are accessory proteins required for the incorporation of Ni in the lactate racemase apoprotein. LarA contains 18 beta-strands and 16 alpha-helices arranged in a novel fold composed of two domains of similar size. This entry represents the N-terminal domain of LarA and related proteins [[cite:PUB00085157]].
family.name: Lactate racemase N-terminal domain
